ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Raising the BARS: Becoming a Research Scientist. Comprehensive introduction to the tools and skills required to transition from undergraduate to graduate school or a professional job in science. Emphasis is on acquiring skills required for independent scientific research, including how to propose and conduct a research project and how to communicate results by writing publication-quality manuscripts and presenting talks and posters at meetings. MEETS IN 277 MORRILL H ALL
